action.objective: Verify a2b1 at max depth as the reserved suggestion, checking king safety and Black replies.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gave a2b1 exact score 0, best of the root; a2b3 had only an upper bound. Rooks on h2/h8 target the h-file and a2 king, so single-candidate verification of a2b1 with reserves is needed. Black rook on h2 already eyes c2/g2; stepping to b1 moves off the second rank and keeps b2 defended by king only.
